Agriculture | U.S. Representative Brian Babin As a lifelong resident of Southeast Texas, I understand our agriculture industry’s impact on the state. It is a $100 billion industry in Texas and is vital to our national security, economy, and the health and well-being of our citizens.<br /> <br /> No one knows Texas’ agriculture needs more than our farmers, ranchers, and timber growers. In Congress, I am working to advance policies and solutions that ensure our farmers and ranchers thrive. I am also fighting to eliminate burdensome and unnecessary regulations that adversely impact the farming and ranching industry. From farm dust and spilled milk to tractor tire ruts in a field, over-zealous regulators in previous administrations have undermined our farming families by imposing policies that are entirely too intrusive.<br /> <br /> Quite frankly, we have had too many bureaucrats sitting down at these federal agencies trying to think of new ways to regulate people. Over the last four years of united Democrat control, federal spending has ballooned dramatically. Despite record-high revenues, Democrat spending continues to leave us with record-high deficits. Clearly, Washington doesn’t have a revenue problem; it has a spending problem.</p> <p>Both parties have contributed to our debt over the years, but we can no longer afford to ignore this problem. Health Care | U.S. Representative Brian Babin I promised the people of the 36th District of Texas that I would repeal Obamacare and replace it with a workable, affordable solution which lowers premiums while protecting those with preexisting conditions. President Trump was elected on this same platform. With the passage of the American Health Care Act (AHCA) in the House on May 4, 2017, we took an important first step in fulfilling that promise. This was perhaps the most important and consequential non-security domestic policy legislation any of us will ever see.<br /> <br /> This bill served as the largest entitlement reform of the Medicaid program in the program's history and eliminated the individual and employer mandate penalties. It also stopped mandatory spending on large abortion businesses, such as Planned Parenthood, for one year.<br /> <br /> It isn't the exact bill I would have written, but I am proud to say that I voted “yes” on the AHCA. While Republicans alone provided the votes to pass this bill, it was still the product of finding common ground to provide the American people with relief from Obamacare. Members of our conference from every ideological stripe and every type of district came together to improve the bill and to secure its passage.<br /> <br /> While we certainly could have written a more ideal bill that allows for insurance sales across state lines, gives consumers better choices about the plans and benefits they want, and tears down the anti-trust exemption for insurers, the absurd tightrope we must walk to comply with the Senate's reconciliation rules forced us to write this bill with one hand tied behind our back.<br /> <br /> Despite its flaws, this bill remained a monumental step forward. The Trump Administration has done much to reverse detrimental policies, but more work is needed from Congress. We must end “catch and release”, through which illegal border crossers, immediately upon setting foot on our soil, can make unjustified claims of persecution and be released into our nation. Serving JSC, the people who work there, and their mission is a top priority of mine in Congress.<br /> <br /> <strong>As Chairman of the House Science, Space and Technology Committee, I have and will continue working to pass legislation to support NASA, ensure human spaceflight remains a prominent NASA objective, advance commercial space, and strengthen JSC.<br /> <br /> </strong>I’m incredibly proud to have had a role in ending our reliance on Russia to get to the International Space Station. Once again, we’re launching American astronauts on American rockets from American soil.<br /> <br /> Our investment in human spaceflight advances our technological development, promotes innovation, bolsters our competitiveness on the world stage, and contributes to a stronger economy. History proves the American entrepreneurial spirit can be propelled beyond our world into the final frontier. Great things are on the horizon!</div>"
